objective: Restate and audit the characteristic-two degree-one specialization of Pang v2 Theorem 7.2(a) for random strict ternary CNFs and the one-premise semantic weakening convention.
status: Admitted, conditional: Pang v2 Theorem 7.2(a), specialized to degree one and characteristic two, supplies an exponential node lower bound with high probability for 8n independently sampled uniform strict ternary clauses. The local one-premise semantic weakening convention preserves an exponential node bound. (Narrowed 2026-11-16, referee GUARDED-ROUTE-BRANCH-R1: conditional on Pang's unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint, assumption A84; for degree one also ECCC TR26-316, Theorems 6.5 and 2.3.)
